scope: Six concept boards for inspiration and comparison only; not runtime assets or adopted rules

generation.strategy: One independent call per style board, six calls. Each route's three independent calls dispatched together; no subagents or external API/CLI.

template.exampleCaseIds: 346 and 6 are template catalogue examples only; no example image was opened or copied.

generation.postProcessing: PNG copies byte-identical to generator originals. No image cropping, redraw, upscaling, compositing, or alpha modification.

comparisonControl.layout: Three face-on portrait card faces; labels and board title outside physical cards; no effect or stat areas
glyphStructures: one diagonal stroke breaks through a gap
comparisonControl.note: Motifs are visual metaphors only; no item, material, world rule or new issued card implied. Count of depicted needles is not an effect quantity.

checks.visual: All six generator outputs directly inspected. Three complete card faces per board; labels/title outside face; no card-face effect paragraphs, numerical stats or costs.

specificFindings.a1: Heavy red/black carved shapes and distressed texture. More archaic material than literal seal-script forms; small specks may be reduced later.
specificFindings.a2: Large negative space and very thin pale line shapes. Some strokes resemble weapons; must verify downscaled identity and preserve glyph feel.
specificFindings.a3: Distinctive full-bleed hard-edge shapes and strong color. Highest departure from quiet old-paper workshop palette; not silently chosen as a new scene style.
specificFindings.b1: Rough black woodcut and paper texture, external labels. Dense hatching and edge distress are stronger than minimal target.
specificFindings.b2: Soft mineral color and isolated volume. Result leans sculptural/realistic more than a flat gouache illustration.
specificFindings.b3: Cobalt/iron-red naive hand painting. Expressive and tactile, potentially lighter/playful than existing occult scene.

rights: Original image_gen creations for project-internal ideation. No third-party game screenshot input or runtime asset reuse. Public distribution conditions not expanded.
